hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // "" | gsub("\\\\\\n"; "")'); printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'xcodebuild([[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+([[:space:]]+[^-[:space:]][^[:space:]]*)*|[[:space:]]+(clean|build|archive|analyze|install|docbuild))*[[:space:]]+test(-without-building)?([[:space:]]|$)' || exit 0; case "$cmd" in *KiteloopMobile.xcodeproj*) exit 0 ;; esac; why=$(pgrep -a -f "Kiteloop[.]app/Contents/MacOS/Kiteloop" 2>&1 >/dev/null); st=$?; if [ "$st" -eq 1 ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ "$st" -eq 0 ]; then reason="Kiteloop is running: \`xcodebuild ... test\` and \`... test-without-building\` launch Kiteloop.app as the XCTest host, which terminates the running instance and any autopilot run inside it. Use the build-only verify, or quit Kiteloop first."; else reason="Cannot tell whether Kiteloop is running: pgrep exited $st, which is neither a match (0) nor a clean \"nothing matched\" (1), so the process list was never read${why:+ — $why}. \`xcodebuild ... test\` and \`... test-without-building\` launch Kiteloop.app as the XCTest host and terminate a running instance along with any autopilot run inside it, so an answer that is not \"no\" cannot stand in for one. Use the build-only verify, or fix pgrep."; fi; jq -nc --arg r "$reason" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'
